purpose: Record Wave 4's remote-policy observations, public marketplace count reconciliation, non-release boundary, remaining independent-proof requirements, and recommended follow-up decision without turning a feature-branch update into merge, signing, deployment, independent installation, or public-release evidence.

hostReported: Changes must be made through a pull request.
remotePolicyObservations.interpretation: The host accepted the named feature-branch update while retaining policy observations. This is not a merge, a protected default-branch write, code-scanning success, or a verified-signature claim.

approvalsStillRequired: any public release, deployment, signing, or publication action

recommendedFollowUp.purpose: Collect separately authorized independent installation or clean-runner evidence only when an approved environment and human release decision exist.

risks.description: Feature-branch host acceptance can be misconstrued as satisfying PR, scanning, signature, or protected-branch policy.
risks.mitigation: Store each policy observation verbatim as a classification, retain all corresponding approval states as pending, and never infer merge or release.

risks.description: Public source availability and count reconciliation can be misconstrued as independent installation proof.
risks.mitigation: Keep independentInstallation=false and link the still-pending evidence and human-approval gates.

rollback.scope: Revert the focused public-boundary decision and related tracker references on the feature branch; no external state, release, publication, or data migration exists.
